notes: Apply these at the Cloudflare/WAF layer before traffic reaches Node.
Keep Express rate limits enabled too; edge limits protect origin capacity, app limits protect per-user business rules.
Tune thresholds after a fresh k6 run against production-like infra.

rules.name: FitLook OTP send
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.fitlook.example" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/otp/send" and http.request.method eq "POST")

rules.name: FitLook AI Studio and Amazon search
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.fitlook.example" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path in {"/api/recommendations/studio-chat" "/api/recommendations/stylist-chat" "/api/products/amazon-search"})

rules.name: FitLook image try-on generation
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.fitlook.example" and http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/tryons") and not (http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/tryons/[^/]+/video$"))

rules.name: FitLook video try-on generation
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.fitlook.example" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/tryons/[^/]+/video$")

rules.name: FitLook uploads
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.fitlook.example" and http.request.method in {"POST" "PATCH"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/api/auth/profile" "/api/auth/body-photo" "/api/closet/items" "/api/closet/items/analyze"})
